clips.text: One who thinks in terms of superiority will always remain inferior because these are two aspects of the same coin.
Sow the seeds of superiority and you will reap the crop of inferiority.
Begin with the longing for superiority and you will end up with nothing but interiority and all the hell that is involved in it.
Begin with humbleness, with humility, and you are nearer to the divine.
In fact you are divine but the ego will not allow you any gap to look into your own divinity.
it will go on creating new, imaginary heavens only to make way for new hells Enter heaven and you are entering hell!

Beware of this, and beware of your so-called self - the creator of all the agonies that exist on earth Be a no-self and you will be that which you are already and have been always - that which is bliss eternal, and freedom, and the cosmic being, the brabman.
Tat twam asi - that art thou, my love.
